question_en: Is the property offered for sale, for long-term rent or for holiday rent?
options_en: venta: For sale. | alquiler: For long-term rent, paid monthly. | alquiler_vacacional: For holiday rent by days or weeks.

question_en: What kind of property is it?
options_en: piso: Flat or apartment in a building. | atico: Penthouse: top-floor flat, usually with a terrace. | duplex: Flat on two floors. | casa: House, not described as a villa or a terraced house. | chalet: Detached villa, usually with a plot or garden. | adosado: Terraced or semi-detached house. | estudio: Studio: one main room with kitchen and bathroom. | local: Commercial premises or shop. | oficina: Office. | terreno: Land or plot. | garaje: Parking space or garage on its own.

question_en: Is {candidate} the current asking price of the property, and not the community fees, the property tax, a deposit or a previous price?
true_en: Yes: it is the current asking price (the monthly rent if it is rented out).
false_en: No: it is another amount, or a previous price.

question_en: Is {candidate} the built area of the property, and not the usable area or the plot?
true_en: Yes: it is the built area.
false_en: No: it is the usable area, the plot, a terrace or another figure.

question_en: Is {candidate} the usable (net) floor area of the property?
true_en: Yes: it is the usable floor area.
false_en: No: it is the built area, the plot or another figure.

question_en: Is {candidate} the size of the plot or land that comes with the property?
true_en: Yes: it is the plot size.
false_en: No: it is the built area or another figure.

question_en: Is {candidate} the number of bedrooms?
true_en: Yes: it is the number of bedrooms.
false_en: No: it counts other rooms, or it is another number.

question_en: Is {candidate} the number of bathrooms?
true_en: Yes: it is the number of bathrooms (full bathrooms and toilets, as stated).
false_en: No: it is another number.

question_en: Is {candidate} the floor the property is on, counting the ground floor as 0?
true_en: Yes: it is the floor number.
false_en: No: it is the number of floors of the building, a door number or another figure.

question_en: Which floor position does the property have in the building?
options_en: sotano: Basement, below street level. | bajo: Ground floor. | entresuelo: Mezzanine, between the ground floor and the first floor. | intermedia: A middle floor. | ultima: The top floor, not described as a penthouse. | atico: Penthouse floor.

question_en: Is {candidate} the monthly community (homeowners' association) fee?
true_en: Yes: it is the monthly community fee.
false_en: No: it is the price, the property tax, another period or another amount.

question_en: Is {candidate} the yearly property tax (IBI)?
true_en: Yes: it is the yearly property tax.
false_en: No: it is the community fee, another period or another amount.

question_en: Is {candidate} a previous asking price that has since been lowered?
true_en: Yes: it is a previous price that was reduced.
false_en: No: it is the current price or another amount.

question_en: Does the listing say that the price is negotiable?
true_en: Yes: the price is described as negotiable, open to offers or similar.
false_en: No: nothing says the price is negotiable.

question_en: Is the property sold with a tenant already living in it (for example "ideal for investors, currently rented")?
true_en: Yes: it is sold with a sitting tenant or an active lease.
false_en: No: it is sold vacant or nothing says it is rented.

question_en: Is {candidate} the yearly rental yield that the listing claims?
true_en: Yes: it is the yield the listing claims.
false_en: No: it is another percentage.

question_en: Does the property have a terrace?
true_en: Yes: the property has its own terrace (not a small balcony, not only a shared roof).
false_en: No: it has no terrace or it is not mentioned.

question_en: Does the property have a balcony?
true_en: Yes: it has at least one balcony.
false_en: No: it has no balcony or it is not mentioned.

question_en: Does the property come with a parking space, and is it included in the price?
options_en: incluido: A parking space is included in the price. | opcional: A parking space is available for an extra price. | no_tiene: There is no parking space.

question_en: Does the property include a storage room?
true_en: Yes: it includes a storage room.
false_en: No: it has no storage room or it is not mentioned.

question_en: Does the building have a lift (elevator)?
true_en: Yes: the building has a lift.
false_en: No: there is no lift or it is not mentioned.

question_en: Does the property have access to a swimming pool?
options_en: privada: A private pool for this property only. | comunitaria: A shared pool of the building or the residential complex. | no_tiene: There is no pool.

question_en: Does the property have air conditioning?
true_en: Yes: it has air conditioning (split units or ducted).
false_en: No: it has no air conditioning, or only pre-installation, or it is not mentioned.

question_en: Does the property have a heating system?
true_en: Yes: it has central, individual or underfloor heating, or heat pumps.
false_en: No: it has no heating or it is not mentioned.

question_en: Which direction do the main rooms of the property face?
options_en: norte: North. | sur: South. | este: East. | oeste: West. | noreste: North-east. | noroeste: North-west. | sureste: South-east. | suroeste: South-west.

question_en: Do the main rooms face the street or an open space (exterior) or an inner courtyard (interior)?
options_en: exterior: Exterior: the main rooms face the street or an open space. | interior: Interior: the main rooms face an inner courtyard or light well.

question_en: What condition is the property in?
options_en: a_reformar: Needs a full renovation. | para_actualizar: Usable, but kitchen, bathrooms or finishes need updating. | buen_estado: Good condition, ready to move in. | reformado: Recently renovated. | a_estrenar: New, never lived in.

question_en: How much natural light does the property get?
options_en: oscuro: Dark, little natural light. | poca_luz: Some natural light, not much. | luminoso: Bright. | muy_luminoso: Very bright, lots of natural light.

question_en: How quiet are the property and its surroundings?
options_en: muy_ruidoso: Very noisy (busy road, nightlife). | algo_ruidoso: Some noise. | tranquilo: Quiet. | muy_tranquilo: Very quiet.

question_en: What is the quality of the finishes and materials?
options_en: basica: Basic finishes. | media: Standard finishes. | alta: High-quality finishes. | lujo: Luxury finishes and materials.

question_en: What kind of views does the property have?
options_en: mar: Sea views. | montana: Mountain or countryside views. | ciudad: City views. | jardin: Garden or park views. | sin_vistas_destacables: No notable views are mentioned.

question_en: Can the property be reached without steps (step-free access, suitable for wheelchairs)?
true_en: Yes: the listing says it has step-free or adapted access.
false_en: No: it has steps or it is not mentioned.

question_en: Is the property offered furnished?
true_en: Yes: it is offered furnished.
false_en: No: it is unfurnished or it is not mentioned.

question_en: Is the property subsidised or price-controlled housing (VPO or similar protection)?
true_en: Yes: it is subsidised housing, with sale or rent restrictions.
false_en: No: nothing says it is subsidised housing.

question_en: Is the property occupied by people without a legal right to live there?
true_en: Yes: the listing says it is illegally occupied ("okupado", "sin posesión").
false_en: No: nothing says it is illegally occupied.

question_en: Is only the bare ownership sold (someone else keeps the right to live in it)?
true_en: Yes: only the bare ownership is sold ("nuda propiedad").
false_en: No: the full ownership is sold or it is not mentioned.

question_en: Is the property sold through an auction or a foreclosure process?
true_en: Yes: it is sold at auction or comes from a foreclosure process.
false_en: No: nothing says it is an auction.

question_en: Does the listing mention debts, liens or other charges on the property?
true_en: Yes: it mentions debts or charges on the property.
false_en: No: nothing is said about debts or charges.

question_en: What is the energy rating of the property?
options_en: a: Energy rating A. | b: Energy rating B. | c: Energy rating C. | d: Energy rating D. | e: Energy rating E. | f: Energy rating F. | g: Energy rating G. | en_tramite: The energy certificate is being processed. | exento: The property is exempt from the energy certificate.

question_en: Does the listing state that the property has a tourist rental licence?
true_en: Yes: it states a tourist licence or its registration number.
false_en: No: nothing is said about a tourist licence.
